reason: I would follow the page and take the free pack, but I would not pay for a brand nobody in my cat groups has heard of. This is my first cat and I am scared of upsetting her stomach with something I cannot check.
objection: I have never heard of PetMetro and the offer does not tell me where it is made, what is in it, or whether anyone's cat has eaten it for weeks without a problem. 'No pork ingredients' is good, but it does not tell me it is safe.
would_change_my_mind: If my cat finished the free pack with no vomiting or loose stool and I saw other Miri cat owners in my Facebook group say they have been feeding it without problems, I would go back to the booth and buy a few pouches.
